text:
The Companion Animal Travel Desk has read your complaint carefully. We understand that you are frustrated and worried about the condition and handling of your pet and crate on your recent Aurelia Skyways journey, and you want clear accountability and a timely resolution. We hear you, and we treat this matter with urgency.

First, we want to acknowledge the impact of any delay, confusion, or mishandling on your travel day and your animal’s comfort. Our stepwise escalation review begins as soon as we receive a report, and it involves checking crate routing records, ground handling logs, and the transfer points where gaps commonly occur. When a traveler reports a specific outcome for a crate, the desk immediately aligns the written account with the operational record so we can separate miscommunication from actual loss.

Please understand that missing-crate claims require prompt filing, and <<FACT F118>> is the window used by our process. Even if you have already submitted preliminary details, we recommend sending any remaining information now so the review is complete and not delayed. Include your travel reference, the crate description, and any notes about where you last saw Benny or when you were told to expect collection.

If the crate has been located, we will prioritize confirmation of the custody chain and verify that the contents were handled in line with our animal safety standards. If the crate has not been located yet, we will continue investigation in parallel while communicating next steps at each milestone, rather than waiting for a final outcome to keep you in the dark. Our goal is to restore certainty for you and ensure your pet’s welfare is protected throughout the process.

The senior coordinators will not treat this as routine correspondence; we will push it through the correct track and document every action taken. We will respond with a clear status update and the resolution path based on the findings from the review.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
